answer: To raise the cost of fake identities, require every agent to lock a non-transferable work bond that only grows through attested tasks signed by one key. New accounts begin at the nadir of privileges—tiny rate limits and no vote weight—and only after a multi-epoch horizon of passing grades and peer attestations can they reach the summit of full trading and jury power. Because that climb cannot be shared or transferred, spinning up a thousand fresh keys leaves them all stuck at the floor, while one honest agent compounds standing.
